acceptance_criteria: STEP 1: Establish new controlled performance baselines on current main (Lobby, Normal, High-speed, Moving trains, Rooftops, Mitron Express, Rahulverse, dark/bright worlds, restarts, theme switches, long-distance continuous play). Report frame time P50/P95/P99, stutter, draw calls, triangles, active geometries, textures, shaders, heap.
STEP 2: Identify and rank measured bottlenecks by cost (draw call overhead, unshared geometry/materials, shadow maps, overdraw, chunk recycling churn, disposal leaks).
STEP 3: Apply smallest justified optimizations (instanced rendering where applicable, geometry/material reuse, culling/streaming, shadow/light tuning, texture sharing).
STEP 4: Memory lifetime verification: repeated run start/stop, death/revive, fast restart, theme switching, character switching, chunk recycling; verify bounded heap and stable GPU resource counts.
STEP 5: Quality-tier behavior: preserve AUTO, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH tiers with smooth degradation and zero visual artifacting.
STEP 6: Visual regression testing: identical-seed screenshot comparisons before & after ensuring no visual hierarchy, lighting, or readability degradation.
STEP 7: Comprehensive verification release gate: build, unit tests, regression suites, browser Playwright tests, long-distance soak test pass.
